bounded_claim: A pure native-motion decision layer and UI-ready projection now exist for semantic heartbeat transitions, including a summary fallback for pure removals. The existing OperatorOverlayService does not consume that policy yet; Android motion remains unproven.
acceptance: node cue requires node transition truth + frame motion permission + visible heartbeat surface + platform animators enabled
collapsed/hidden presentation and platform-disabled animation block the cue
evidence-only refresh and interrupted preserved frames earn no cue
pure removal is represented by the existing heartbeat summary rather than a synthetic replacement light
source artifact respects reduced-motion and remains explicitly source-only
new doctrine preserves the existing OperatorOverlayService as sole native owner

review_scar.found: The first summary-fallback policy collapsed two distinct rejection reasons into NODE_HAS_NO_TRANSITION.
review_scar.repair: FRAME_MOTION_CLAMPED and NODE_OWNS_TRANSITION are now distinct fail-closed boundaries before the final source review.

findings.finding: Motion now has a deterministic pure policy instead of remaining an unused boolean with ad hoc future interpretation.
A removal-only structural transition is explicitly projected to the existing summary surface because no removed node remains to animate.
Presentation visibility and platform animation permission are mandatory; motion is supplementary and does not alter speech, selection, focus, authority, or execution.
OperatorOverlayService currently ignores HeartbeatNativeMotionPolicy decisions. Existing-owner native motion consumption is not implemented in this slice.
